biggest_catch: The $100 only arrives after 60 days with both accounts active and current — early cancellation or a missed payment forfeits it.
catches: Both you and your friend must be customers for 60 days and current on bills before rewards post.
The referred customer must enroll in a non-Solar Buyback plan of 12 months or longer.
Rewards are points redeemable as bill credit — savings on energy spending, not cash income.
Rhythm may withhold rewards for enrollments that came from general online search rather than your direct referral.

payout_value_note: $100 in Rhythm Rewards points per qualifying referral, to both referrer and friend; no referral limit.

steps: Sign up for Rhythm Energy on a non-Solar Buyback plan of 12 months or longer.
Copy your unique referral link from the Refer A Friend button in your customer portal.
Have your friend sign up with your link.
Once both you and your friend have been customers for 60 days with bills current, you each receive $100 in Rhythm Rewards points.
Redeem the points as a credit toward your bill from your account.
timing: Sharing a link takes minutes; rewards post after 60 days as bill credit.
